Download datasets and compute their metrics

Source: R/core-functions.R
dg_download_many.Rd

Wrapper that downloads several datasets with dg_pull_dataset(), computes their summary metrics with summarise_datasets() and returns both the raw downloaded tibbles and the metrics in a single list.

Usage

dg_download_many(ids, remove_na = FALSE)

Arguments

ids

A character vector of dataset identifiers to download (or exact titles, as a fallback). Identifiers are the stable, unique values in the id column of dg_list_datasets().

remove_na

Whether to drop rows containing any NA value (passed to dg_pull_dataset()). Defaults to FALSE.

Value

A list with two components:

datasets

A named list of the downloaded tibbles. A ZIP dataset may contribute several tables, each named after its file.

metrics

A tibble of summary metrics, as returned by summarise_datasets().

�

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
out <- dg_download_many("6397c0ff56d3963118a18345")
names(out)
out$metrics
head(out$datasets[[1]])
}
